# WA Flooring Specialist

> Owner-led flooring contractor based in Moncks Corner, South Carolina. WA Flooring Specialist installs floors, sands and refinishes hardwood, and handles trim and finish carpentry, tile and painting for homes in Moncks Corner and the greater Charleston area. The crew has worked in flooring since 2010 (company founded in 2018). Every estimate is free and starts with an on-site visit.

Key facts:

- Website: https://waflooring.escolats.com.br (test environment)
- Phone and text: +1 (843) 822-5964
- Email: luanleal0209@gmail.com
- Based in: Moncks Corner, SC 29461
- Service area: Moncks Corner, Goose Creek, Summerville, Hanahan, Charleston and Mount Pleasant; nearby towns on request
- Facebook: WA Art in Wood
- Preferred contact: call or text
- Experience: flooring since 2010, 15+ years
- Estimates: free, after an on-site visit
- Materials: customer supplied or company supplied
- Not offered: carpet, sheet vinyl

## Main page

- [Home](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/): services, 3D floor designer, flooring inspiration gallery, process, FAQ and the free estimate form

## Services

- [Floor Installation](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#services): hardwood, custom wood patterns like herringbone, luxury vinyl plank (LVP) and tile; other floor types reviewed project by project
- [Hardwood Sanding and Refinishing](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#services): scratches, stains and worn finish removed so the original wood comes back
- [Trim and Finish Carpentry](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#services): wood trim and finish work that frames each room
- [Tile and Ceramic](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#services): bathrooms, kitchens and backsplashes
- [Painting](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#services): interior painting with clean lines, so one crew can finish the whole room

## How it works

- [Process](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#how): 1. contact us by form, call or text, 2. on-site visit and free estimate, 3. the job done right
- [Floor Designer](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#design): try plank patterns (straight, herringbone, chevron), wood finishes and sheen in 3D
- [Free estimate form](https://waflooring.escolats.com.br/#estimate): service, phone, ZIP code and contact preference
